test_title: PYST 26: Selection Post (Graduation Level) - Reasoning (Held On 3 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that represents the letters which when sequentially placed from left to right in the blanks below will complete the letter series.

P _ I _ Y _ O _ U Y P _ K U _ P O _ _ Y

options.text: O U P J O Y K U
O U P I O Y L U
O U P J O Y L U
O V P J O Y K U

solution:
Given: P _ I _ Y _ O _ U Y P _ K U _ P O _ _ Y

Let's check each option:

1) O U P J O Y K U → P __**O**__ I __**U**__ Y - __**P**__ O __**J**__ U Y - P __**O**__ K U __**Y -**__ P O __**K**__ __**U**__ Y

2) O U P I O Y L U → P __O__ I __U__ Y - __P__ O __I__ U Y - P __O__ K U __Y -__ P O __L__ __U__ Y

3) **O U P J O Y L U** → P __O__ I __U__ Y - __P__ O __J__ U Y - P __O__ K U __Y -__ P O __L__ __U__ Y

__
 
• Here we can see a pattern.
 
 
• 3rd letter is increasing by +1, rest letters are the same.
 
• I + 1 = J; J + 1 = K; K + 1 = L
 
 

4) O V P J O Y K U → P O__ I __V__ Y - __P__ O __J__ U Y - P __O__ K U __Y -__ P O __K__ __U__ Y

Hence, ‘O U P J O Y L U’ is the correct answer.
